text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ————I want to be the leading lady.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
The very first time I thought that...
was that unforgettable day I first stood in
the center.

text_block_list.name: Young Dantsu
text_block_list.text: —Yaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Dantsu Flame-chan crosses the finish line!
The winner is Dantsu Flame-chan!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
What incredible talent...!
Her future is so bright,
she was sparkling out there!
Congratulations!
You're gonna grow up to be an amazing
horsegirl!

text_block_list.name: Young Dantsu
text_block_list.text: Whoa...! Incredible...!!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
That view from atop the center of the podium,
clutching my medal.
That dazzling moment where it felt like
everyone saw me as special.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Until then,
my own outline had always felt so hazy,
but that profound emotion made it feel as
though I was clearly projected into this
world.

text_block_list.name: Young Dantsu
text_block_list.text:
"*sigh*... Letters stopped coming again...
...I guess it can't be helped.
Everyone forgets eventually...——"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Because of my father's job,
I transferred schools a lot when I was
little.
Making friends in a new place was never that
hard, but—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
...Every time contact with my friends faded,
I couldn't help thinking:
I'm just a wispy,
faint presence with nothing memorable about
me.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I'm in people's sights,
but I'm not special...
And because I'm not special,
I can never be number one...——

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Because I'm not number one,
I leave no lasting impression.
And so,
I just end up forgotten...
A mere "supporting character."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
But when I was running...
only when I was racing, it was different.
That single moment when I tore across the
line in first place...
I was the "leading lady"...!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I want to stand in the center again...!
I want to shine even brighter and become a
"leading lady" that stays in everyone's
memories...!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I was so genuinely happy when I worked my
hardest and got accepted into Tracen
Academy. I thought,
now I can finally become the leading lady
on the grandest stage.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: —... But I realized it soon enough.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
At this academy,
there are so many girls blessed with immense
talent...
girls who were born to be "leading ladies"
from the very start.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
...Every time I see their dazzling brilliance,
I'm reminded:
I'm still nowhere close to being a "leading
lady" at all.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Even so... Even if that's true...!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: I don't... want to give up...!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... *gasp*... *pant*...
No... No, no! At this rate,
it's not enough at all...!!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I can't win like this...!
I have to maintain top speed longer...
or I won't even be able to put up a fight...!
And yet—... AAAAAHHH!!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
(————
Girls who can be "leading ladies," like
Pokke-chan and Tachyon-chan,
would have won their selection races without
question...!)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
(And yet, I couldn't win...!
I wasn't enough,
I couldn't reach them...!!)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
(...I'm sure even Trainer doesn't believe
that I could ever become a "leading
lady.")

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I have to prove it...!
That it's okay for me to debut...!
That I can aim to be the "leading lady"!!
—YAAAAAHHHH!!

...I pick up Dantsu Flame's future training
regimen
lying on the desk,
and draw a giant 'X' across it.

Every single plan written here...
is completely meaningless,
drawn up by someone who wasn't truly standing
by her side.

That gentle,
soft atmosphere like warm sunshine when we
first met.
I had mistaken that for the entirety of
Dantsu Flame's true nature.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
...Um.
I'm still nowhere near ready to be a leading
lady, but...
even so...
I look forward to working with you!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I didn't win,
did I? In the selection race.

...The real her harbors a fierce,
burning desire
to reach for victory—
to become the "lead protagonist."

Like a blazing flame.
...That blazing figure is the true Dantsu
Flame—
...A few days later.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: So, I really can run in the mock race...?!
choice_data_list: Yeah. I officially submitted the a...
Yeah. I officially submitted the a...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Really...?! 
I promise, I'll definitely win...!

With that,
I lowered my head to Dantsu Flame.
To apologize for how disrespectfully I had
treated her until now.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Wh-Why all of a sudden...?! 
Please lift your head up...!

I raised my head,
looking straight into her eyes,
and laid everything bare.
The impressions I once held.
How I felt when I first scouted her.

And the fact that, until today,
I had never truly aimed for the "lead role"
alongside her.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Trainer...
choice_data_list: I'm going to make sure you win thi...
I'm going to make sure you win thi...

text_block_list.text:
This is something I must accomplish if I am
to truly stand beside her as her Trainer.
Therefore—
choice_data_list: If we lose, let's terminate our co...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Huh—?
choice_data_list: Don't worry about your debut. I've...

text_block_list.text:
In the event that I fail to keep my promise,
I have already reached out to a successor
who agreed to take over her training.

Fortunately,
someone with far more experience and
achievements than me agreed to help.
Under their guidance,
she is guaranteed to be steered steadily
forward.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Th-That's not what I mean...! 
Terminating our contract...
you can't be serious...!
choice_data_list: I will make you the lead. I want t...
I will make you the lead. I want t...

text_block_list.text:
What Dantsu Flame needs is a Trainer who
can lead her to victory.
If I cannot prove I am that person,
I have no right to stand by her side.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
...I understand.
So this is just how serious you are,
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Then I... I'll face it head-on too.
I will definitely win.
And I'll prove it...!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I'll prove that I can fight right alongside
Pokke and the others...
that I'm an Umamusume who can take center
stage...!

And so, with unwavering resolve,
we took our first steps together toward the
mock race that would decide our fate—
